# Proteomic Analysis

This is a pipeline for **differential expression** analysis in **proteomics** and contains 5 parts. To continue further analysis you need to choose **normalization** technique, **imputation** method, **minimum razor peptide** amount, **min MSMS** count, **filtration**. Also for DEA you need to choose **logFC** value and significant value of **adjusted p value**.

* Configuration, Data & Packages
* Data Processing
* Quality Control (QC)
  + PCA Analysis for LFQ intensities
  + Relative Amount of Contaminants
  + Number of Identified Proteins
  + LFQ (log2) Intensities BoxPlot
  + Correlation Plot LFQ Intensities
  + Overlap Heatmap
* Differential Expression Analysis
  + Volcano Plot
  + HeatMap

---

## Part 1: Configuration & Data Loading
First thing first you need to define your working director and you need to have **proteinGroups.txt**, **Design.txt** and **Contrast.txt** as tab delimetted text file. In here you need to define your configuration values like normalization, imputation etc. Also you can define **order of groups** in the graphs, **splitting** heatmap into the groups

* normalization_method = "vsn"      # Options: "none", "quantile", "vsn", "median.centering"
* imputation_method = "none"        # Options: "normal", "min", "global", "none"
* min_razor_peptides = 2            
* min_msms_count = 3                
* min_valid_percent = 0.70          
* logFC_threshold = 0.54            # 1.5x up or down regulate           
* adj_pval_threshold = 0.05
* min_valid_type = "percent"        # Options: "percent", "count"
* min_valid_percent = 0.70          # Used if min_valid_type == "percent", recommended: 70%
* dea_method = "limma"              # Options: "limma", "deqms"
* deqms_count_col = "Peptides"      # Options: "Peptide", "MS/MS count"
* run_logistic_regression = FALSE   # If TRUE: performs logistic regression biomarker analysis
```{r config, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(vsn)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(DEqMS)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(pROC)
library(readxl)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggsci)

# --- PIPELINE CONFIGURATION ---
data_dir <- "C:/Users/serife-ayaz/Desktop/AORT_Final" # You should change directory name
out_dir <- "C:/Users/serife-ayaz/Desktop/AORT_Final"  # You should change directory name
normalization_method <- "vsn" # Options: "none", "quantile", "vsn", "median.centering"
imputation_method <- "none" # Options: "normal", "min", "global", "none"
min_razor_peptides <- 2 # Recommended: 2
min_msms_count <- 3 # Recommnded: 3
min_valid_type <- "percent" # Options: "percent", "count"
min_valid_percent <- 0.70 # Used if min_valid_type == "percent", recommended: 70%
min_valid_count <- 1 # Used if min_valid_type == "count", recommended 2
logFC_threshold <- 0.54 # 0.54 = 1.5x fold change, 0.413 1.33xFC, 0.263 1.2xFC
adj_pval_threshold <- 0.05
p_val_type <- "adj_pvalue" # Options: "adj_pvalue", "pvalue"
split_heatmap <- FALSE # Recommended: False
heatmap_exclude_groups <- c() # you can remove specific group from heatmap just write column names in your Design_.txt like c("Control_1","Control2")
dea_method <- "deqms" # Options: "limma", "deqms", it is used for more powerful statistical analysis, recommended limma at first
deqms_count_col <- "Peptides" # Only active if dea_method="deqms". Common Options: "Peptides", "MS/MS count", "Razor + squared peptides"
group_order <- c() # You can order your group just writing names
draw_pca_ellipse <- FALSE # Options: TRUE, FALSE. Set to TRUE to draw dashed ellipses around groups in PCA, FALSE to skip.
# ------------------------------

proteinGroups_raw <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "proteinGroups.txt"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
design <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "design.txt"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
contrast <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "contrast.txt"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Define global NPG colors for consistent groups (e.g. AS, AR)
unique_groups_global <- unique(design$groups)
npg_colors <- ggsci::pal_npg("nrc")(max(length(unique_groups_global), 3))[1:length(unique_groups_global)]
names(npg_colors) <- unique_groups_global
```

---

## Part 2: Preprocessing & Filtration

Proteins are filtered in this step according to configuartion filter paramateres. You can track proteins amount in the table.

```{r preprocessing, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- proteinGroups_raw

# Filter tracking data frame
filter_tracking <- data.frame(Step = "Initial Proteins", Count = nrow(df))

# 1. Reverse & Contaminant Filtresi
if ("Reverse" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df[is.na(df$Reverse) | df$Reverse != "+", ]
if ("Potential contaminant" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df[is.na(df$`Potential contaminant`) | df$`Potential contaminant` != "+", ]
if ("Only identified by site" %in% colnames(df)) df <- df[is.na(df$`Only identified by site`) | df$`Only identified by site` != "+", ]

filter_tracking <- rbind(filter_tracking, data.frame(Step = "After Reverse/Contaminant Removal", Count = nrow(df)))

# Number of Identified Proteins
sample_names <- design$samples

# Dynamically and robustly detect intensity columns in proteinGroups
find_intensity_cols <- function(df, sample_names) {
  # 1. Try "LFQ intensity "
  lfq_cols <- paste0("LFQ intensity ", sample_names)
  if (all(lfq_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
    mat <- as.matrix(df[, lfq_cols])
    if (sum(mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      return(list(cols = lfq_cols, type = "LFQ intensity"))
    }
  }
  
  # 2. Try "Intensity "
  int_cols <- paste0("Intensity ", sample_names)
  if (all(int_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
    mat <- as.matrix(df[, int_cols])
    if (sum(mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      return(list(cols = int_cols, type = "Intensity"))
    }
  }
  
  # 3. Try "iBAQ "
  ibaq_cols <- paste0("iBAQ ", sample_names)
  if (all(ibaq_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
    mat <- as.matrix(df[, ibaq_cols])
    if (sum(mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      return(list(cols = ibaq_cols, type = "iBAQ"))
    }
  }
  
  # 4. Exact match
  if (all(sample_names %in% colnames(df))) {
    return(list(cols = sample_names, type = "Exact"))
  }
  
  # 5. Fuzzy match (ends with sample name)
  matched_cols <- c()
  for (s in sample_names) {
    found <- colnames(df)[grepl(paste0("(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9])", s, "$"), colnames(df))]
    if (length(found) > 0) {
      matched_cols <- c(matched_cols, found[1])
    }
  }
  if (length(matched_cols) == length(sample_names)) {
    return(list(cols = matched_cols, type = "Fuzzy"))
  }
  
  # Fallback to LFQ if nothing else works
  return(list(cols = lfq_cols, type = "LFQ intensity"))
}

detected <- find_intensity_cols(df, sample_names)
lfq_cols <- detected$cols
cat(paste("Automatically detected intensity column type:", detected$type, "\n"))

raw_intensity <- as.matrix(df[, lfq_cols])
raw_intensity[raw_intensity == 0] <- NA
identified_per_sample_raw <- colSums(!is.na(raw_intensity))

# 2. Razor ve MS/MS Filter
razor_col <- grep("Razor", colnames(df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
msms_col <- grep("MS/MS count", colnames(df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

if (length(razor_col) > 0) {
  keep_razor <- apply(df[, razor_col, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) any(x >= min_razor_peptides, na.rm = TRUE))
  df <- df[keep_razor, ]
}
if (length(msms_col) > 0) {
  # if one of ms/ms col contains maximum value bigger than threhsold kept it
  keep_msms <- apply(df[, msms_col, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) any(x >= min_msms_count, na.rm = TRUE))
  df <- df[keep_msms, ]
}

filter_tracking <- rbind(filter_tracking, data.frame(Step = "After Razor and MS/MS Filter", Count = nrow(df)))

# 3. LFQ Matrix and Normalization
intensity_matrix <- as.matrix(df[, lfq_cols])
intensity_matrix[intensity_matrix == 0] <- NA

if (nrow(intensity_matrix) == 0 || all(is.na(intensity_matrix))) {
  stop("Error: The intensity matrix is completely empty (all values are NA or 0). Please verify that your sample names in design.txt match the column headers in proteinGroups.txt exactly, or check if the selected intensity type contains non-zero values in your dataset.")
}

if (normalization_method == "none") {
  norm_matrix <- log2(intensity_matrix)
} else if (normalization_method == "quantile") {
  norm_matrix <- preprocessCore::normalize.quantiles(intensity_matrix)
  dimnames(norm_matrix) <- dimnames(intensity_matrix)
  norm_matrix <- log2(norm_matrix)
} else if (normalization_method == "median.centering") {
  log2_temp <- log2(intensity_matrix)
  global_median <- median(log2_temp, na.rm = TRUE)
  col_medians <- apply(log2_temp, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  norm_matrix <- sweep(log2_temp, 2, col_medians, FUN = "-")
  norm_matrix <- norm_matrix + global_median
} else {
  if (nrow(intensity_matrix) < 42) {
    stop("Error: Too few proteins (less than 42) remaining to perform VSN normalization. Please check your filtering thresholds (min_razor_peptides, min_msms_count) or verify that your sample names match the column headers in proteinGroups.txt.")
  }
  vsn_model <- vsn::vsn2(intensity_matrix)
  norm_matrix <- predict(vsn_model, newdata = intensity_matrix)
}

log2_matrix <- norm_matrix
colnames(log2_matrix) <- sample_names

# 4. Valid Values Filter
keep_rows <- apply(log2_matrix, 1, function(x) {
  counts <- tapply(x, design$groups, function(g) sum(!is.na(g)))
  group_sizes <- tapply(x, design$groups, length)

  if (min_valid_type == "percent") {
    any((counts / group_sizes) >= min_valid_percent)
  } else {
    any(counts >= min_valid_count)
  }
})

# Find the exact count column dynamically if DEqMS is used
actual_count_col <- NULL
if (dea_method == "deqms") {
  # Starts with search to catch "Peptides", "MS/MS count" etc.
  matched_cols <- grep(paste0("^", deqms_count_col), colnames(df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(matched_cols) == 0) {
    stop(paste("Count column '", deqms_count_col, "' not found in data for DEqMS analysis!"))
  }
  actual_count_col <- matched_cols[1]
  df_filtered <- df[keep_rows, c("Protein IDs", "Gene names", actual_count_col, lfq_cols)]
} else {
  df_filtered <- df[keep_rows, c("Protein IDs", "Gene names", lfq_cols)]
}
filter_tracking <- rbind(filter_tracking, data.frame(Step = paste0("After Valid Values Filter (", min_valid_type, ")"), Count = nrow(df_filtered)))

# First gene name for better readability in Graphs
df_filtered$`Gene names` <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(df_filtered$`Gene names`), ";"), `[`, 1)
df_filtered$`Protein IDs` <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(df_filtered$`Protein IDs`), ";"), `[`, 1)

log2_filtered <- log2_matrix[keep_rows, ]
log2_filtered_pre_imputation <- log2_filtered

# 5. Imputation
if (imputation_method == "normal") {
  for (j in 1:ncol(log2_filtered)) {
    col_na <- is.na(log2_filtered[, j])
    if (any(col_na)) {
      mean_val <- mean(log2_filtered[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_val <- sd(log2_filtered[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
      log2_filtered[col_na, j] <- rnorm(sum(col_na), mean = (mean_val - 1.8 * sd_val), sd = (0.3 * sd_val))
    }
  }
} else if (imputation_method == "min") {
  for (j in 1:ncol(log2_filtered)) {
    col_na <- is.na(log2_filtered[, j])
    if (any(col_na)) log2_filtered[col_na, j] <- min(log2_filtered[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
} else if (imputation_method == "global") {
  log2_filtered[is.na(log2_filtered)] <- min(log2_filtered, na.rm = TRUE)
}

kable(filter_tracking, caption = "Protein Count After Each Filtration Step") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Part 3: Quality Control (QC)

### 3.1. PCA Analysis
```{r qc_pca_combined, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# 1. Raw LFQ (Log2)
mat_raw_lfq <- as.matrix(df[keep_rows, lfq_cols])
mat_raw_lfq[mat_raw_lfq == 0] <- NA
mat_log2_lfq <- log2(mat_raw_lfq)

# 2. iBAQ (Log2)
ibaq_cols <- paste0("iBAQ ", sample_names)
mat_log2_ibaq <- NULL
if (all(ibaq_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
  ibaq_matrix <- as.matrix(df[keep_rows, ibaq_cols])
  ibaq_matrix[ibaq_matrix == 0] <- NA
  mat_log2_ibaq <- log2(ibaq_matrix)
}

# 3. Imputed (based on Normalized)
# Amica'nın arka planda PCA çizebilmek için yaptığı muhtemel "downshifted normal" imputation simülasyonu
mat_imputed <- log2_filtered
for (j in 1:ncol(mat_imputed)) {
  col_na <- is.na(mat_imputed[, j])
  if (any(col_na)) {
    mean_val <- mean(mat_imputed[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_val <- sd(mat_imputed[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
    mat_imputed[col_na, j] <- rnorm(sum(col_na), mean = (mean_val - 1.8 * sd_val), sd = (0.3 * sd_val))
  }
}

# 4. Normalized
mat_norm <- log2_filtered

# Function to calculate PCA and format for ggplot
run_pca_for_plot <- function(mat, name) {
  if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)
  mat_clean <- na.omit(mat)
  if (nrow(mat_clean) > 2 && ncol(mat_clean) > 2) {
    pca_res <- prcomp(t(mat_clean), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
    pc1_var <- round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1)
    pc2_var <- round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1)
    
    df_pca <- data.frame(
      PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1], 
      PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2], 
      Group = design$groups, 
      Sample = design$samples,
      Type = paste0(name, "\n(PC1: ", pc1_var, "%, PC2: ", pc2_var, "%)")
    )
    return(df_pca)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

df_pca_lfq <- run_pca_for_plot(mat_log2_lfq, "1. Log2 LFQ")
df_pca_ibaq <- run_pca_for_plot(mat_log2_ibaq, "2. iBAQ")
df_pca_norm <- run_pca_for_plot(mat_norm, paste0("3. Normalized (", normalization_method, ")"))
df_pca_imp <- run_pca_for_plot(mat_imputed, "4. Imputed")

pca_all_list <- list(df_pca_lfq, df_pca_ibaq, df_pca_norm, df_pca_imp)
pca_all_list <- pca_all_list[!sapply(pca_all_list, is.null)]
df_pca_all <- do.call(rbind, pca_all_list)

# Type factor ordering to maintain plot order
types <- unique(df_pca_all$Type)
df_pca_all$Type <- factor(df_pca_all$Type, levels = types)

p_pca_all <- ggplot(df_pca_all, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = npg_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ Type, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2")

if (draw_pca_ellipse) {
  p_pca_all <- p_pca_all + stat_ellipse(aes(group = Group), type = "norm", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
}

print(p_pca_all)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "QC_PCA_Combined_Plot.png"), plot = p_pca_all, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Save individual PCA plots
for (pca_type in types) {
  df_single <- df_pca_all[df_pca_all$Type == pca_type, ]
  
  clean_title <- strsplit(as.character(pca_type), "\n")[[1]][1]
  clean_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", clean_title)
  clean_name <- gsub("_+", "_", clean_name)
  clean_name <- sub("^_|_$", "", clean_name)
  
  p_single <- ggplot(df_single, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = npg_colors) +
    labs(title = paste("Principle Component Analysis"), x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))
    
  if (draw_pca_ellipse) {
    p_single <- p_single + stat_ellipse(aes(group = Group), type = "norm", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5)
  }
    
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("QC_PCA_", clean_name, ".png")), plot = p_single, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```


Different groups should cluster **seperatly** for here AD and AY clustered seperatly (AD not that much good)

### 3.2. Relative Amount of Contaminants
```{r qc_contaminants, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
ibaq_cols <- paste0("iBAQ ", sample_names)

ibaq_cols[ibaq_cols == "iBAQ D_4_2"]  <- "iBAQ D_4_2"

if (all(ibaq_cols %in% colnames(proteinGroups_raw))) {
  df_ibaq <- proteinGroups_raw[, c("Reverse", ibaq_cols)]

  category <- rep("Valid", nrow(df_ibaq))
  if ("Decoy" %in% colnames(df_ibaq)) category[df_ibaq$Reverse == "+"] <- "Decoy"
  if ("Potential contaminant" %in% colnames(df_ibaq)) category[df_ibaq$`Potential contaminant` == "+"] <- "Contaminant"
  df_ibaq$Category <- category

  ibaq_long <- df_ibaq %>%
    dplyr::select(Category, all_of(ibaq_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ibaq_cols), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "iBAQ") %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("iBAQ ", "", Sample))

  ibaq_summary <- ibaq_long %>%
    group_by(Sample, Category) %>%
    summarise(Total_iBAQ = sum(as.numeric(iBAQ), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    mutate(Percentage = Total_iBAQ / sum(Total_iBAQ, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
    left_join(design, by = c("Sample" = "samples"))

  p_cont <- ggplot(ibaq_summary, aes(x = Sample, y = Percentage, fill = Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Valid" = "#1f77b4", "Contaminant" = "#d62728")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Relative Amount of Contaminants", y = "iBAQ Intensity (%)", x = "") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

  print(p_cont)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "QC_Contaminants_iBAQ.png"), plot = p_cont, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
} else {
  cat("iBAQ kolonları bulunamadı, bu grafik çizilemiyor.\n")
}
```

### 3.3. Number of Identified Proteins

### 3.3.b Venn Diagram - Proteome Overlap
```{r qc_venn, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
unique_groups <- unique(design$groups)
expressed_lists <- list()

for (grp in unique_groups) {
  grp_samples <- design$samples[design$groups == grp]
  mat <- log2_filtered_pre_imputation[, grp_samples, drop = FALSE]
  
  valid_ratio <- rowSums(!is.na(mat)) / ncol(mat)
  if (min_valid_type == "percent") {
    expressed_idx <- valid_ratio >= min_valid_percent
  } else {
    expressed_idx <- rowSums(!is.na(mat)) >= min_valid_count
  }
  
  proteins_expressed <- df_filtered$`Protein IDs`[expressed_idx]
  proteins_expressed <- proteins_expressed[!is.na(proteins_expressed) & proteins_expressed != ""]
  expressed_lists[[grp]] <- unique(proteins_expressed)
}

# Define dynamic colors based on the global NPG palette
my_colors <- unname(npg_colors[unique_groups])

p_venn <- ggvenn(
  expressed_lists,
  show_percentage = FALSE,
  show_elements = FALSE,
  fill_color = my_colors,
  fill_alpha = 0.55,
  stroke_size = 1.4,
  text_size = 6,
  set_name_size = 6
) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    )
  )

print(p_venn)

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "QC_Venn_Expressed_Proteome.png"),
  p_venn,
  width = 9,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

# Summary Table
cat("\n\n#### Proteome Overlap Summary\n\n")

all_genes <- unique(unlist(expressed_lists))
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, expressed_lists)

overlap_summary <- data.frame(
  Category = c(paste0("Only in ", names(expressed_lists)), "Common in All Groups", "Total Unique"),
  Count = c(
    sapply(names(expressed_lists), function(g) {
      others <- setdiff(names(expressed_lists), g)
      length(setdiff(expressed_lists[[g]], unique(unlist(expressed_lists[others]))))
    }),
    length(common_genes),
    length(all_genes)
  )
)
print(kable(overlap_summary, format = "markdown"))
cat("\n\n")
```

### 3.4. LFQ (log2) Intensities BoxPlot (Pre-Imputation)
```{r qc_boxplot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
boxplot_data <- pivot_longer(as.data.frame(log2_filtered_pre_imputation), cols = everything(), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Intensity")
boxplot_data$Group <- design$groups[match(boxplot_data$Sample, design$samples)]

p_box <- ggplot(boxplot_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Intensity, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = npg_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = paste("Intensities BoxPlot (", normalization_method, ") - Pre-Imputation"), x = "Samples", y = "Normalized Intensity")

print(p_box)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "QC_Intensities_Boxplot_Pre.png"), plot = p_box, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

### 3.4.b LFQ Intensities BoxPlot (Post-Imputation)
```{r qc_boxplot_post, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
boxplot_data_post <- pivot_longer(as.data.frame(log2_filtered), cols = everything(), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Intensity")
boxplot_data_post$Group <- design$groups[match(boxplot_data_post$Sample, design$samples)]

p_box_post <- ggplot(boxplot_data_post, aes(x = Sample, y = Intensity, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = npg_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = paste("Intensities BoxPlot (", imputation_method, " imputed)"), x = "Samples", y = "Imputed Intensity")

print(p_box_post)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "QC_Intensities_Boxplot_Post.png"), plot = p_box_post, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

### 3.7. Mean-Variance Trends
```{r qc_variance_trend, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
int_cols <- paste0("Intensity ", sample_names)
if (all(int_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
  mat_int <- as.matrix(df[keep_rows, int_cols])
} else {
  mat_int <- as.matrix(df[keep_rows, lfq_cols])
}

lfq_specific_cols <- paste0("LFQ intensity ", sample_names)
if (all(lfq_specific_cols %in% colnames(df))) {
  mat_lfq <- as.matrix(df[keep_rows, lfq_specific_cols])
} else {
  mat_lfq <- as.matrix(df[keep_rows, lfq_cols])
}

mat_int[mat_int == 0] <- NA
mat_lfq[mat_lfq == 0] <- NA

mat_log2_lfq <- log2(mat_lfq)
mat_norm <- log2_filtered_pre_imputation
mat_imputed <- log2_filtered

calc_mv <- function(mat, name, is_log) {
  valid_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(mat)) > 1
  mat_clean <- mat[valid_rows, , drop=FALSE]
  
  row_mean <- apply(mat_clean, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  row_sd <- apply(mat_clean, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # voom/vooma stili x ekseni (ortalama log2 intensity veya log2(ortalama raw intensity))
  x_val <- if(is_log) row_mean else log2(row_mean + 1)
  
  data.frame(
    Mean = x_val,
    Sqrt_SD = sqrt(row_sd),
    Type = name
  )
}

df_mv_int <- calc_mv(mat_int, "1. Raw Intensity", is_log = FALSE)
df_mv_lfq <- calc_mv(mat_lfq, "2. LFQ Intensity", is_log = FALSE)
df_mv_log2 <- calc_mv(mat_log2_lfq, "3. Log2(LFQ)", is_log = TRUE)
df_mv_norm <- calc_mv(mat_norm, paste0("4. Normalized (", normalization_method, ")"), is_log = TRUE)
df_mv_imp <- calc_mv(mat_imputed, paste0("5. Imputed (", imputation_method, ")"), is_log = TRUE)

df_mv_all <- rbind(df_mv_int, df_mv_lfq, df_mv_log2, df_mv_norm, df_mv_imp)

p_var <- ggplot(df_mv_all, aes(x = Mean, y = Sqrt_SD)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "red", se = FALSE, span = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Type, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mean-Variance Trends (Vooma Style)", 
       x = "Average log2 Expression", 
       y = "Sqrt( standard deviation )")

print(p_var)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "QC_Mean_Variance_Trends.png"), plot = p_var, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## Part 4: Differential Expression Analysis

You can analyze all comparisons defined in your `contrast.txt` file automatically.

### 4.1. Differential Expression Analysis & Tables
```{r dea_analysis, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
# --- Heatmap Column Ordering ---
if (length(group_order) > 0 && all(design$groups %in% group_order)) {
  design$groups <- factor(design$groups, levels = group_order)
} else {
  design$groups <- factor(design$groups)
}

order_idx <- order(design$groups)
design_ordered <- design[order_idx, ]
log2_filtered_ordered <- log2_filtered[, order_idx]

groups <- factor(design$groups)
design_matrix <- model.matrix(~ 0 + groups)
colnames(design_matrix) <- levels(groups)

fit <- lmFit(log2_filtered, design_matrix)

all_results <- data.frame()

for (comp_idx in 1:nrow(contrast)) {
  g1 <- contrast$group1[comp_idx]
  g2 <- contrast$group2[comp_idx]
  comp_name <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
  comp_str <- paste0(g1, "-", g2)
  cat("\n\n### Comparison: ", comp_name, "\n\n")

  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = comp_str, levels = design_matrix)
  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

  if (dea_method == "deqms") {
    counts <- sapply(df_filtered[[actual_count_col]], function(x) {
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";"))))
      if (all(is.na(vals))) return(1) else return(max(vals, na.rm = TRUE))
    })
    fit2$count <- counts
    
    unique_counts <- length(unique(counts))
    if (unique_counts < 2 || length(counts) < 20) {
      fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
      results <- topTable(fit2, sort.by = "none", n = Inf)
    } else {
      fit3 <- tryCatch({ spectraCounteBayes(fit2) }, error = function(e) { NULL })
      if (is.null(fit3)) {
        fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
        results <- topTable(fit2, sort.by = "none", n = Inf)
      } else {
        res_deqms <- outputResult(fit3, coef_col = 1)
        res_deqms <- res_deqms[rownames(fit2$coefficients), ]
        results <- res_deqms
        results$P.Value <- res_deqms$sca.P.Value
        results$adj.P.Val <- res_deqms$sca.adj.pval
      }
    }
    if ("sca.t" %in% colnames(results)) results$t <- results$sca.t
  } else {
    fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
    results <- topTable(fit2, sort.by = "none", n = Inf)
  }

  res_df <- cbind(df_filtered[, c("Protein IDs", "Gene names")], results)
  
  # Ensure clean Gene column with fallback to Protein ID if Gene is missing
  gene_clean <- res_df$`Gene names`
  gene_clean[is.na(gene_clean) | gene_clean == ""] <- res_df$`Protein IDs`[is.na(gene_clean) | gene_clean == ""]
  res_df$Gene <- gene_clean

  res_df <- cbind(res_df, log2_filtered)

  res_df$Significant <- "Not Significant"
  if (p_val_type == "pvalue") {
    res_df$Significant[res_df$logFC > logFC_threshold & res_df$P.Value < adj_pval_threshold] <- "Enriched"
    res_df$Significant[res_df$logFC < -logFC_threshold & res_df$P.Value < adj_pval_threshold] <- "Reduced"
  } else {
    res_df$Significant[res_df$logFC > logFC_threshold & res_df$adj.P.Val < adj_pval_threshold] <- "Enriched"
    res_df$Significant[res_df$logFC < -logFC_threshold & res_df$adj.P.Val < adj_pval_threshold] <- "Reduced"
  }

  res_df$Comparison <- comp_name
  all_results <- rbind(all_results, res_df)
  
  dea_filtered <- res_df %>% filter(Significant != "Not Significant") %>% arrange(desc(logFC))

  write.csv(dea_filtered, file.path(out_dir, paste0("absolute_proteins_", comp_name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(res_df, file.path(out_dir, paste0("all_proteins_", comp_name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  enriched <- dea_filtered %>% filter(Significant == "Enriched") %>% arrange(desc(logFC))
  reduced <- dea_filtered %>% filter(Significant == "Reduced") %>% arrange(logFC)

  top_enriched <- head(enriched, 10)
  top_reduced <- head(reduced, 10)

  cat("\n#### Top 10 Enriched Proteins\n\n")
  print(kable(top_enriched[, c("Protein IDs", "Gene names", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")], format = "markdown"))

  cat("\n\n#### Top 10 Reduced Proteins\n\n")
  print(kable(top_reduced[, c("Protein IDs", "Gene names", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")], format = "markdown"))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### 4.2. Volcano Plot
```{r volcano_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (comp_name in unique(all_results$Comparison)) {
  res_df <- all_results %>% filter(Comparison == comp_name)
  enriched <- res_df %>% filter(Significant == "Enriched") %>% arrange(desc(logFC))
  reduced <- res_df %>% filter(Significant == "Reduced") %>% arrange(logFC)
  top_genes <- rbind(head(enriched, 10), head(reduced, 10))
  
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(comp_name, "_vs_"))
  g1 <- parts[1]; g2 <- parts[2]

  if (p_val_type == "pvalue") {
    p_volcano <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = Significant)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "red", "Reduced" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "gray")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFC_threshold, logFC_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(adj_pval_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label = `Gene names`), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
      labs(title = paste("Volcano Plot -", comp_name), x = paste("Log2 Fold Change (", g1, "vs", g2, ")"), y = "-Log10(P-value)")
  } else {
    p_volcano <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = Significant)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "red", "Reduced" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "gray")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFC_threshold, logFC_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(adj_pval_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label = `Gene names`), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
      labs(title = paste(comp_name), x = paste("Log2 Fold Change (", g1, "vs", g2, ")"), y = "-Log10(Adjusted P-value)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")
  }

  cat("\n#### Volcano Plot - ", comp_name, "\n\n")
  print(p_volcano)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("DEA_Volcano_Plot_", comp_name, ".png")), plot = p_volcano, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### 4.3. All Heatmap (Including NAs)
```{r all_heatmap_with_na, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (comp_name in unique(all_results$Comparison)) {
  res_df <- all_results %>% filter(Comparison == comp_name)
  sig_proteins <- res_df %>% filter(Significant != "Not Significant")
  
  if (nrow(sig_proteins) > 2) {
    heatmap_mat <- log2_filtered_ordered[res_df$Significant != "Not Significant", ]
    row_labels <- sig_proteins$`Gene names`
    row_labels[row_labels == "" | is.na(row_labels)] <- sig_proteins$`Protein IDs`[row_labels == "" | is.na(row_labels)]
    rownames(heatmap_mat) <- make.unique(row_labels)

    anno_col_ordered <- data.frame(Group = design_ordered$groups)
    rownames(anno_col_ordered) <- colnames(log2_filtered_ordered)
    
    cols_to_keep <- !anno_col_ordered$Group %in% heatmap_exclude_groups
    heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, cols_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
    anno_col_ordered <- anno_col_ordered[cols_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]

    # Padding groups with spaces to force pheatmap to add extra right margin for the legend
    anno_col_ordered$Group <- paste0(anno_col_ordered$Group, "      ")
    padded_npg_colors <- npg_colors
    names(padded_npg_colors) <- paste0(names(npg_colors), "      ")

    # Custom robust scaling for 'With NA' heatmap to preserve NAs
    scaled_mat_with_na <- t(apply(heatmap_mat, 1, function(y) {
      sdev <- sd(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.na(sdev) || sdev == 0) {
        y_scaled <- rep(0, length(y))
        y_scaled[is.na(y)] <- NA
        return(y_scaled)
      }
      (y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdev
    }))
    dimnames(scaled_mat_with_na) <- dimnames(heatmap_mat)
    
    # Calculate robust distance avoiding NAs
    row_cor_with_na <- cor(t(scaled_mat_with_na), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    row_cor_with_na[is.na(row_cor_with_na)] <- 0
    row_dist_with_na <- as.dist(1 - row_cor_with_na)

    cat("\n#### Heatmap (Including NAs) - ", comp_name, "\n\n")
    pheatmap(scaled_mat_with_na,
      scale = "none", annotation_col = anno_col_ordered,
      annotation_colors = list(Group = padded_npg_colors),
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      clustering_distance_rows = row_dist_with_na,
      show_rownames = (nrow(scaled_mat_with_na) < 50),
      na_col = "white",
      border_color = NA,
      main = paste("Heatmap (With NAs) -", comp_name),
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("DEA_Heatmap_WithNA_", comp_name, ".png")), width = 9, height = 9, res = 300
    )
    cat(paste0("![Heatmap (With NAs) - ", comp_name, "](", file.path(out_dir, paste0("DEA_Heatmap_WithNA_", comp_name, ".png")), ")\n\n"))
  } else {
    cat("\nYeterli anlamli protein bulunamadi, Heatmap cizilemiyor: ", comp_name, "\n\n")
  }
}
```

### 4.5. Top 50 Heatmap (Top 25 Up / 25 Down)
```{r top50_heatmap, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (comp_name in unique(all_results$Comparison)) {
  res_df <- all_results %>% filter(Comparison == comp_name)
  enriched <- res_df %>% filter(Significant == "Enriched") %>% arrange(desc(logFC))
  reduced <- res_df %>% filter(Significant == "Reduced") %>% arrange(logFC)
  
  top_enriched_split <- head(enriched, 25)
  top_reduced_split <- head(reduced, 25)
  top50_split <- rbind(top_enriched_split, top_reduced_split)
  
  if (nrow(top50_split) > 2) {
    sig_indices_50_split <- which(df_filtered$`Protein IDs` %in% top50_split$`Protein IDs`)
    heatmap_mat_50_split <- log2_filtered_ordered[sig_indices_50_split, ]
    
    row_labels_50_split <- df_filtered$`Gene names`[sig_indices_50_split]
    row_labels_50_split[row_labels_50_split == "" | is.na(row_labels_50_split)] <- df_filtered$`Protein IDs`[sig_indices_50_split][row_labels_50_split == "" | is.na(row_labels_50_split)]
    rownames(heatmap_mat_50_split) <- make.unique(row_labels_50_split)
    
    anno_col_ordered <- data.frame(Group = design_ordered$groups)
    rownames(anno_col_ordered) <- colnames(log2_filtered_ordered)
    cols_to_keep <- !anno_col_ordered$Group %in% heatmap_exclude_groups
    heatmap_mat_50_split <- heatmap_mat_50_split[, cols_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
    
    anno_col_ordered <- anno_col_ordered[cols_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Padding groups with spaces to force pheatmap to add extra right margin for the legend
    anno_col_ordered$Group <- paste0(anno_col_ordered$Group, "      ")
    padded_npg_colors <- npg_colors
    names(padded_npg_colors) <- paste0(names(npg_colors), "      ")

    # Scale row-wise robustly
    scaled_mat_50_split <- t(apply(heatmap_mat_50_split, 1, function(y) {
      sdev <- sd(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (is.na(sdev) || sdev == 0) y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE) else (y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)) / sdev
    }))
    colnames(scaled_mat_50_split) <- colnames(heatmap_mat_50_split)
    rownames(scaled_mat_50_split) <- rownames(heatmap_mat_50_split)
    
    col_cor_50_split <- cor(scaled_mat_50_split, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    col_cor_50_split[is.na(col_cor_50_split)] <- 0
    col_dist_50_split <- as.dist(1 - col_cor_50_split)
    
    row_cor_50_split <- cor(t(scaled_mat_50_split), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    row_cor_50_split[is.na(row_cor_50_split)] <- 0
    row_dist_50_split <- as.dist(1 - row_cor_50_split)
    
    cat("\n#### Top 50 Heatmap - ", comp_name, "\n\n")
    pheatmap(scaled_mat_50_split,
      scale = "none", annotation_col = anno_col_ordered,
      annotation_colors = list(Group = padded_npg_colors),
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      clustering_distance_cols = col_dist_50_split,
      clustering_distance_rows = row_dist_50_split,
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      na_col = "white",
      border_color = NA,
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("DEA_Heatmap_Top50_", comp_name, ".png")), width = 9, height = 9, res = 300
    )
    
    cat(paste0("![Top 50 Heatmap - ", comp_name, "](", file.path(out_dir, paste0("DEA_Heatmap_Top50_", comp_name, ".png")), ")\n\n"))
  } else {
      cat("\nYeterli anlamli protein bulunamadi, Heatmap cizilemiyor: ", comp_name, "\n\n")
  }
}
```
